# First Baptist Church Muncie

> First Baptist Church Muncie is a Christian congregation in downtown Muncie, Indiana, at 309 East Adams Street, Muncie, IN 47305. Sunday worship is at 10:45am. The church has been part of downtown Muncie for generations and describes itself as a Spirit-led people gathered to join Christ's presence in our community.

## Pages that exist on this site today

- [Home](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/): Who the church is, when it gathers, and how to visit
- [Visit](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/visit/): What a Sunday morning is like, where to park, the building, and accessibility
- [Who we are](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/who-we-are/): The church's watchword, goals and pledge, in its own words
- [What we believe](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/beliefs/): Basic beliefs, the confession, what being American Baptist means, and membership
- [Ministries](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/ministries/): Worship, children, youth, adults and outreach, with who to ask about each
- [Pastors and staff](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/staff/): The pastors, the staff, the Church Coordination Team and the deacons
- [Our history](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/history/): The congregation's story from its founding, and the 1929 building
- [Weddings](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/wedding/): Getting married here, the spaces, the documents and how to reserve the building
- [Give](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/give/): Three ways to give and what a gift supports
- [Contact](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/contact/): Phone, email, address, office and pastors' hours, and how to share a life update
- [Blog](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/blog/): Sermon previews, church news, reflections and the Visitor quarterly, newest first
- [Privacy policy](https://www.fbcmuncie.org/privacy/): How this site handles your information

Individual posts live at /post/<slug>. The blog is also browsable by page
(/blog/page/2), by category (/blog/category/<slug>) and by tag

## Visiting

- Address: 309 East Adams Street, Muncie, IN 47305, downtown at the corner of Jefferson and Adams
- Sunday worship: 10:45am
- Website: https://www.fbcmuncie.org
